title: Double Indemnity
description: An insurance man (Fred MacMurray) helps a platinum blonde (Barbara Stanwyck) kill her husband, but all does not go as planned.

title: The Best Man
description: Presidential contenders (Henry Fonda, Cliff Robertson) vie for their party's nod and a dying ex-president's blessing.

title: The Scarlet and the Black
description: Defying a Nazi colonel (Christopher Plummer), Vatican Monsignor Hugh O'Flaherty (Gregory Peck) hides thousands of escaped POWs in occupied Rome.

title: Blue Montana Skies
description: A singing cowboy (Gene Autry) and his sidekick (Smiley Burnette) find fur smugglers with a clue written on a rock.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E10 — Mr. Buntline's Vacation
Broke journalist Ned Buntline enlists Earp's help when he arrives in Dodge City and claims a crooked gambler wants him dead; Earp meets an undercover officer who believes the gambler may instead be in town to sell stolen guns to the Apache.

title: Bandit Queen
description: A young woman (Barbara Britton) becomes a masked avenger after gold-grabbers kill her Spanish parents in old California.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E11 — Fortitude
When Earp learns of a plot against his life, he avoids speaking at a convention held in the Dodge City Opera House and increases security, but as pressure builds for him to speak, Judge Tobin and Mayor Kelley wonder if Earp can still do his job.

title: 2026 Silver Eagle is here & it is a once-in-a-lifetime coin!
description: Join your hosts Kevin Cash & Cory Cady as we discuss the 250th Anniversary of America with the official "America 250" logo on a Silver American Eagle label; we are locking in orders for this iconic release, but coins are limited! Don't miss out!

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E12 — The Good and Perfect Gift
A boy named Benny Burkett attaches himself to Doc Holliday and ends up under the Hollidays' official care after being forced to shoot his abusive father in self-defense; Dr. McCarty delivers news that shakes the newly formed family.

title: The Catholic Mass
description: The Heart of the nation Sunday mass brings the beauty and traditions of the Catholic faith.

title: Perry Stone
description: Religious teachings from Perry Stone.

title: Paid Programming
description: Paid programming.

title: Call of the Canyon
description: A radio saleswoman (Ruth Terry) helps a singing cattleman (Gene Autry) trap a shady meat buyer with a bogus broadcast.

title: The Deadline
description: A cowboy (Buck Jones) framed for murder gets out of prison and tracks down the real killer.

title: Sierra Stranger
description: Jess Collins, a poor miner, helps Sonny chase off two men he calls claim jumpers. When he arrives in the nearby town, he learns Sonny is no good and everyone in town is against him.

title: The Stalking Moon
description: An Army scout (Gregory Peck) rescues a white woman (Eva Marie Saint) and her half-Indian son from their renegade captors.

title: Rancho Notorious
description: An outlaw (Mel Ferrer) brings a cowboy (Arthur Kennedy) to a ranch hide-out run by a retired saloon singer (Marlene Dietrich).

title: The Turning Point
description: A newsman (William Holden) follows a crime-committee chairman (Edmond O'Brien) out to bust a syndicate and corruption.

title: Sunset Boulevard
description: Hack screenwriter Joe Gillis moves in with Hollywood has-been Norma Desmond and her devoted chauffeur, Max Von Mayerling.

title: Breaker Morant
description: Australian Lt. Morant and two fellow officers are court-martialed for executing Boer War prisoners.

title: Shotgun
description: A deputy sheriff (Sterling Hayden) seeks justice with a woman (Yvonne De Carlo), a bounty hunter (Zachary Scott) and a sawed-off shotgun.

title: Comin' Round the Mountain
description: A singing cowboy (Gene Autry) saves a señorita's (Ann Rutherford) ranch and wins a horse race on a mustang.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E13 — Indian Wife
While Dick Delaney and his Cheyenne wife, Laura, visit Dodge City, a lecherous man confronts Laura, forcing her to shoot him; Laura retreats to find protection with her father, a chieftain who wants Dick to kill the man who assaulted her.

title: The Cisco Kid in Old New Mexico
description: The Cisco Kid (Duncan Renaldo) and Pancho (Martin Garralaga) free a girl (Gwen Kenyon) accused of murder, then find the killer.

title: Through the Bible With Les Feldick
description: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E14 — Woman Trouble
A gang coerces a woman into courting Earp to learn information about a gold shipment they plan to rob, but Bat and Mayor Kelley see through the ruse.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E15 — Shadow of a Man
When Earp and Bat leave town to arrest train robbers, Hal Norton must wrangle the remaining deputies to deal with numerous problems that spring up in Dodge City while the ever-doubtful Mayor Kelley seeks to replace him.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E16 — Bad Woman
When the people of Dodge City capture the brother of gang leader Marie Burden in a robbery, Marie confronts Earp, willing to do whatever it takes to free him.

title: Black Patch
description: A one-eyed marshal (George Montgomery) puts a bank-robbing buddy in jail, but two greedy locals try to get him out.

title: Mackenna's Gold
description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

title: The Third Man
description: Visiting postwar Vienna, a writer (Joseph Cotten) of pulp Westerns probes the suspicious death of an old friend (Orson Welles).

title: In a Lonely Place
description: A bungalow neighbor (Gloria Grahame) alibis a boozing Hollywood screenwriter (Humphrey Bogart) accused of murder.

title: Munster, Go Home
description: Herman (Fred Gwynne), Lily (Yvonne De Carlo), Grandpa (Al Lewis) and their ghoulish TV family go to England to claim an estate.

title: Apache War Smoke
description: Indians chase a Mexican bandit (Gilbert Roland) to his long-lost son's (Robert Horton) stage station.

title: Return of the Durango Kid
description: A stagecoach passenger poses as a masked avenger to track down the thieves who robbed him and his companions.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E17 — One-Man Army
When a newspaper editor drums up anti-Northern sentiment by launching a smear campaign aimed at Earp, the marshal takes a leave of absence to confront a Texas gang working with the editor.

title: South of Monterey
description: The Cisco Kid (Gilbert Roland), Pancho (Martin Garralaga) and a dancer try to outfox a swindler.

title: Through the Bible With Les Feldick
description: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E18 — The General's Lady
When a scout from the Battle of the Little Big Horn tries to blackmail Gen. Custer's widow, she fears he plans to provide damaging testimony at an upcoming hearing for Maj. Reno; Earp must convince her that her husband was a courageous man.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E19 — The Manly Art
Unscrupulous businessman Moresby, seeking a way to permanently cripple Earp, convinces a boxing promoter to have his champ beat Earp, but the marshal refuses to take up the challenge until the champ's blatant cheating injures a young man in the ring.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E20 — Sweet Revenge
Earp begins dating Mrs. Phillips, a widowed seamstress, but fears for her safety as word arrives in Dodge City that a convict Earp helped put away has escaped and wants revenge.

title: Wild Stallion
description: Raised by a cowboy (Edgar Buchanan) at a cavalry fort, an orphan becomes an officer (Ben Johnson) and looks for his long-lost horse.

title: The Mob
description: An undercover officer (Broderick Crawford) tracks waterfront corruption from California to New Orleans and back.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
description: A country bumpkin faces ridicule and corruption when he takes his idealistic views to the nation's capital.

title: State of the Union
description: An heiress (Angela Lansbury) wants a self-made man (Spencer Tracy) to run for president with his estranged wife (Katharine Hepburn) by his side.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E21 — The Imitation Jesse James
Earp arrests a stagecoach robber who copies the style of Jesse James, but the witnesses refuse to testify, and the robber goes free, leading Earp to enlist the skill of a cheating gambler to set a trap for him.

title: Stranger From Arizona
description: A quiet cowboy (Buck Jones) on a white horse saves a gal (Dorothy Fay) from cattle rustlers.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S03 E22 — The Kansas Lily
A former Confederate spy asks Earp and Bat to help her escape from her dead brother's gang; Bat develops feelings for the woman, but Earp, doubting her story, obeys a warrant calling for her arrest.

title: Beauty and the Bandit
description: The Cisco Kid (Gilbert Roland) and Chico (Martin Garralaga) secure the deed to a woman's ranch.

title: Through the Bible With Les Feldick
description: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S01 E31 — Hunt the Man Down
Earp must enter the rough Bushwhacker region to find a man suspected of murder, but his behavior once found leads Earp to believe the man is not guilty of the crime.
